claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 May 1866, p. 8, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
Our European files by the Cuba reached this city from
Boston yesterday evening. The papers are dated to the
12th of May, and contain very important details of the
rise and progress of the financial disasters in England,
already reported by telegraph, with a report showing to
what extent the panic prevailed on the Continent.
